summary: Master the art of tourism marketing with our focused training program. Learn innovative strategies to enhance your brand and drive visitor engagement.
lede: Tourism marketing training is for destination, hospitality, tour operator, and tourism program professionals who need to build demand and assess campaign results. It covers traveler segmentation and positioning, offer and channel planning, partnership development, and performance measurement to help participants connect marketing activity with inquiries, bookings, and revenue.
audienceIntro: This course is designed to meet the needs of a diverse range of tourism professionals seeking to enhance their marketing strategies and drive demand.
audience: Travel agency and tour operator sales
County or public sector staff in tourism
modules: Market Research, Segmentation, and Traveler Personas
Positioning and Value Proposition for Destinations and Experiences
Product Packaging and Offer Design That Converts
Full-Funnel Campaign Planning for Tourism Growth
Distribution and Partnerships That Drive Demand
Reputation, Reviews, and Brand Trust Management
Tourism Marketing Operations and Team Execution
prerequisites: Participants should have prior experience in marketing or tourism, with a basic understanding of digital marketing concepts. Familiarity with marketing analytics tools is beneficial but not required.
